::: {#def-row-vector-derivative}
#### Row-vector derivative
If $f(\vb)$ is a scalar-valued function of a $p \times 1$ vector $\vb$,
such as $f(\vb) = \tp{\vx}\vb$,
then its **row-vector derivative** is:

$$
\deriv{ \vb\'} f(\vb) =
\sbmat{
\deriv{\beta_1}f(\vb) &
\deriv{\beta_2}f(\vb) &
\cdots &
\deriv{\beta_p}f(\vb)
}
$$

The row-vector derivative is also called the **total derivative** of $f$,
the name used when the derivative of a scalar-valued function is written as a row.
:::
